name: Elena Rodriguez Garcia
bio:
Elena Rodriguez Garcia's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with her grandfather's tales of rally racing. After completing her studies in supply chain management, she found herself drawn to the complex logistical challenges presented by racing. She started as a junior coordinator at a small touring car team, learning the ropes of international transport and resource management.

Over the years, Elena honed her expertise, becoming known for her ability to anticipate problems and devise creative solutions under pressure. Her meticulous approach to planning and her knack for building strong relationships with suppliers and vendors have earned her a reputation as a highly reliable logistics coordinator. She thrives in the fast-paced environment of the paddock and is particularly adept at navigating customs regulations and ensuring that all equipment and personnel arrive at each race location on time and in perfect condition. Elena's detail-oriented nature and unwavering dedication have made her an invaluable asset to any team she joins. 

Elena joined Cadillac Racing three years ago and has been instrumental in streamlining their European operations, working tirelessly to ensure that the team's equipment is where it needs to be, when it needs to be there.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a kind face framed by expressive eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously organized checklists.
Has a habit of speaking in logistics jargon even in casual conversations.
Insists on having a specific brand of Spanish coffee available at every event.
